texts_per_file.0010.png: In the evening, little Candy hugged Tom and Jerry dolls, curled up on the sofa watching cartoons. The sun set outside the window, and she was dubbing the cartoon with her mouth, having a great time.
texts_per_file.0020.png: Suddenly, a pale cyan light filled the living room. Stella, wearing a pale cyan Hanfu and holding an oil-paper umbrella, walked out of the light, her skirt fluttering as light as willow leaves.
texts_per_file.0030.png: Stella said to little Candy that it had been a long time since they met. This time she invited Candy to Chengdu in the Tang Dynasty to witness Du Fu writing a poem. Candy's eyes sparkled with joy, and she nodded eagerly, hugging the dolls tightly in her arms.
texts_per_file.0040.png: Stella chanted a spell and called her little friends! Tom stretched lazily, and Jerry jumped down from Tom's ear and made a face. Candy jumped up in surprise.
texts_per_file.0050.png: Thump! Thump! Thump! Spike ran in with Tyke, and Tyke rubbed Candy's feet with his tail wagging. Jerry introduced that this was his cousin Nibbles, who poked his head out of his pocket.
texts_per_file.0060.png: Stella opened the oil-paper umbrella, and with a turn, the umbrella surface became a glittering vortex, with the sound of rain and the smell of green grass coming from it. Everyone held hands, excitedly ready to set off.
texts_per_file.0070.png: Plop! Everyone fell into the vortex. The wind whistled in their ears, and the scenery changed rapidly. In the blink of an eye, they landed on a soft black soil.
texts_per_file.0080.png: It was pitch black all around, and drizzle was falling. Candy found herself wearing a ink wash coir raincoat, the wristband on her wrist turned into a jade ring (Runwu Order), and her feet were cloud-patterned rain-listening boots.
texts_per_file.0090.png: Stella told everyone to keep their voices down. This was Huanhuaxi in Chengdu in the second year of Shangyuan in the Tang Dynasty, next to Du Fu's Thatched Cottage. It was a spring night, and after a long drought, the much-needed rain had come; they must not disturb the poet.
texts_per_file.0100.png: Tom sniffed the soil, thinking it was like a litter box, and was about to squat down to dig a hole to relieve himself. Jerry was quick-eyed and quick-handed, kicked Tom flying with one foot to stop him from destroying the vegetable field.
texts_per_file.0110.png: Tom fell to the ground with a wronged look on his face. Jerry put his hands on his hips and shouted: This is Mr. Du Fu's vegetable seedlings, not your toilet! Everyone quickly pulled Tom up.
texts_per_file.0120.png: The window of the thatched cottage lit up. Du Fu pushed open the window and stretched out his hand to catch the rain. His hair was gray, and his eyes were gentle and hopeful. Stella whispered that this was Du Fu, the Sage of Poetry who cared about the country and the people.
texts_per_file.0130.png: Looking at Du Fu, Candy also felt hopeful in her heart. The Runwu Order on her wrist glowed green, and she could feel the dry land under her feet greedily drinking water.
texts_per_file.0140.png: Du Fu walked out of the thatched cottage, wearing a plain long shirt, letting the drizzle fall on him. He smiled and sighed: What a good rain, it's finally here. Candy smiled too.
texts_per_file.0150.png: Jerry thought the rain was too quiet and boring, so he took out the miniature cymbals given by Stella, wanting to make a sound. He secretly ran to the big tree, raised the cymbals and prepared to strike hard.
texts_per_file.0160.png: Stella waved her hand gently, and a light shield covered Jerry, making the cymbals unable to ring. Jerry stamped his feet anxiously, but couldn't make a sound, looking confused.
texts_per_file.0170.png: Stella lifted the barrier and told Jerry: This rain 'comes silently with the wind at night', the raindrops are less than 0.5 millimeters, we can't make noise, we have to match its tenderness.
texts_per_file.0180.png: Tom saw Du Fu getting wet in the rain, thinking the gentleman must be very cold, and decided to get him a change of clothes. He ran to pull the corner of Stella's clothes, pointing here and there.
texts_per_file.0190.png: Stella conjured up a big red cloak with small bells hanging on it. Tom was overjoyed, took the cloak in his mouth and ran quickly to Du Fu, wanting to put it on him.
texts_per_file.0200.png: Tom stood on tiptoe trying to put on the cloak, but he was too short, and the small bells on the cloak rang 'jingle jingle'. Du Fu was startled and suddenly turned his head.
texts_per_file.0210.png: Tom thought he had caused trouble, so he quickly hid in the nearby vegetable field and huddled up. Du Fu turned around and only saw the wind blowing the fence, then shook his head with a smile.
texts_per_file.0220.png: Tom poked his head out, saw that Du Fu was not angry, breathed a sigh of relief and climbed out. Candy comforted Tom: You're great, just be quieter next time.
texts_per_file.0230.png: Spike saw that Du Fu was walking inconveniently on the muddy ground, and wanted to help him flatten the road. He walked to the field ridge, raised his big paw and slapped hard: Boom!
texts_per_file.0240.png: As a result, he used too much force and blocked the irrigation ditch that Du Fu had just dredged! Rainwater accumulated, and it was about to submerge the nearby medicinal garden (Du Fu's beloved medicinal herbs).
texts_per_file.0250.png: When Du Fu found out, his face changed drastically. He hurried back to the house to get a torch and a hoe, then ran to the ditch in a hurry to dig up the soil. The night became darker.
texts_per_file.0260.png: Candy was in a hurry, pulling Stella's hand to ask for help. Tom meowed, Jerry jumped up and down, Tyke dug the soil with his paws, but none of them could open the blocked ditch.
texts_per_file.0270.png: Nibbles squatted aside to observe, then suddenly jumped up and said: I have a way! He took out the 'Super Fluffy Candy' given by Stella, saying it could turn the soil as soft as a sponge.
texts_per_file.0280.png: Nibbles threw the fluffy candy into the ditch. The candy cracked, the soil became as fluffy as a sponge, the accumulated water seeped down quickly, the ditch was unblocked, and the medicinal garden was safe!
texts_per_file.0290.png: Seeing the ditch was unblocked, Du Fu's brows relaxed. But he was still worried: the rain kept falling, fearing that the rain would be too heavy and submerge the crops. Stella said she would help him check the rain intensity.
texts_per_file.0300.png: Stella cast a spell, and cyan light fell on Tom's whiskers. Tom's whiskers turned into glittering 'humidity sensors' that could perceive the moisture in the air and soil.
texts_per_file.0310.png: Jerry pushed Tom to Du Fu's side. Tom lowered his head in fear, pretending to be a stray cat sheltering from the rain. When Du Fu saw Tom, he showed a gentle smile.
texts_per_file.0320.png: Du Fu squatted down and touched Tom's head, his fingers touching the glittering whiskers. He could feel that the moisture on the whiskers was just right, neither too heavy nor too light.
texts_per_file.0330.png: Du Fu touched the soil beside him again, it was moist and soft. He finally felt relieved, smiled and said: So this rain is just right, it won't submerge the crops, what a good rain it is!
texts_per_file.0340.png: At this time, the night was thick, the field paths and clouds were all pitch black (Wild paths and clouds are all black). In the distance on the Jinjiang River, the lights of fishing boats twinkled (Only the lights on the river boats are bright).
texts_per_file.0350.png: Du Fu turned around and ran back to the thatched cottage, and everyone quietly followed behind. Du Fu walked to the desk, lit an oil lamp, took out an inkstone and a writing brush, ready to splash ink and write.
texts_per_file.0360.png: But the ink in the inkstone was too dry to write with. Du Fu frowned, picked up the ink ingot and ground it slowly, but the ink was still not moist enough.
texts_per_file.0370.png: Naughty Jerry took the opportunity when Du Fu wasn't looking, sneaked to the desk, and gently spat a little saliva into the inkstone, wanting to help dissolve the ink.
texts_per_file.0380.png: Stella blew a soft breath, and Jerry's saliva turned into 'Inspiration Water'. The ink in the inkstone instantly became jet-black and shiny, with a strong fragrance of ink spreading around.
texts_per_file.0390.png: Candy quietly walked to the door. Her rain-listening boots collected the sound of raindrops falling on leaves, soil and the river surface, turning it into a gentle melody that drifted into the room.
texts_per_file.0400.png: Du Fu picked up the writing brush, dipped it in the jet-black and shiny ink. Guided by the melody of the rain, he moved his wrist and wrote the first line of the poem: Good rain knows its season.
texts_per_file.0410.png: Du Fu wrote while reciting softly: Good rain knows that spring has come, knows that the crops need it, so it comes on time. He didn't stop writing, and continued to write: It comes just in spring.
texts_per_file.0420.png: The rain outside the window was gentle. Tom and Jerry squatted beside the desk and watched quietly, Spike and Tyke guarded the door, Nibbles squatted beside the inkstone, and Stella watched everything with a smile.
texts_per_file.0430.png: Du Fu's brush strokes became more and more fluent, and he wrote: It follows the wind and slips into the night, Moistening all things silently. He explained: The drizzle comes quietly with the wind at night, moistening all things but making no sound.
texts_per_file.0440.png: Candy looked at her Runwu Order, and could feel the plants growing, just as Du Fu wrote 'Moistening all things silently'.
texts_per_file.0450.png: Du Fu looked up out the window, at the pitch-black fields and clouds, only the fishing fire on the river was bright. He picked up his brush and wrote: Wild paths and clouds are all black, Only the lights on the river boats are bright.
texts_per_file.0460.png: After writing, Du Fu put down his brush and frowned in thought. He was wondering what Chengdu City would look like tomorrow morning after being moistened by the spring rain?
texts_per_file.0470.png: Candy was afraid that Du Fu couldn't figure it out, so she pulled Stella's hand to ask for help. Stella smiled and said: We are helping him imagine the flowers in Jinguan City.
texts_per_file.0480.png: Stella blew a breath, and cyan light fell on the crabapple flower beside the Thatched Cottage. The crabapple flower slowly bloomed at night, with water droplets hanging on the petals, making them heavy.
texts_per_file.0490.png: Du Fu heard the movement and pushed open the window, seeing the blooming crabapple flower with red and heavy petals. His eyes lit up, and he showed a long-lost relaxed smile.
texts_per_file.0500.png: Du Fu hurried back to the desk and wrote the last line: In the morning, see where the red is wet, The flowers weigh down Jinguan City! He exclaimed: Yes! That's it!
texts_per_file.0510.png: After writing, Du Fu stepped back to admire the whole poem, and read it aloud with a satisfied smile. Candy and everyone listened at the door, feeling happy too.
texts_per_file.0520.png: Tom looked at the leftover rice on the desk and swallowed, sneaking forward to steal it. Jerry slapped him flying with one palm, and made a face: No stealing, respect the poet!
texts_per_file.0530.png: Stella said the task was completed and it was time to go back to modern times. She opened the oil-paper umbrella, and the umbrella surface swirled into a cyan vortex, with a faint light covering everyone.
texts_per_file.0540.png: Everyone fell into the vortex and returned to Candy's living room. The coir raincoat and wristband on Candy disappeared, turning back to her original appearance. The dolls also returned to their original state.
texts_per_file.0550.png: Stella stood in the living room and smiled: Did you have a good time today? Did you remember Du Fu's poem? Candy nodded vigorously and replied happily that she remembered it.
texts_per_file.0560.png: Candy walked to the window and pushed it open. It was also drizzling with spring rain outside. The rain drizzled on her face, cool and gentle, just like the rain by Huanhuaxi.
texts_per_file.0570.png: Looking at the rain, Candy seemed to see Du Fu's smiling face again, the crabapple flower, and Tom and Jerry helping out. She knew this was a precious memory.
texts_per_file.0580.png: Stella waved goodbye, her figure slowly became transparent and disappeared into the cyan light: I will take you to more places in the future! Candy stood by the window holding the dolls.
texts_per_file.0590.png: Candy watched the spring rain and recited 'Happy Rain on a Spring Night' at the same time, with a sweet smile on her face. She knew this rain and that tenderness would stay in her heart.
texts_per_file.0600.png: The rain fell gently, like the melody collected by the rain-listening boots. Candy stroked her wrist, as if she could still feel the warmth of the Runwu Order and that silent hope.
